programs.description: A happy family goes through various trials and tribulations and falls apart when greed takes precedence over relationships.
A young, vivacious and educated woman named Gauri does her bit to support her ageing father in his endeavours to write a book and constantly assists those who need her help in reading and writing.

Gauri, an average village girl, falls in love with a wealthy city man, Samir. Later, when Samir goes abroad to study law, the unusual couple must survive turmoil.
